title: Add a human-friendly status table view
description: Add a --human flag to appbuilder status that prints a concise table (claim, branch, expiry, next action) derived from the data deriveStatus() already computes, with next action chosen per bucket (active -> work/handoff, expired -> release --expired, merged_unreleased -> release, orphaned -> prune). Keep JSON as the default output so agents that parse status are unaffected. Written test-first.
acceptance_criteria: appbuilder status with no flag still emits valid JSON (unchanged contract).
appbuilder status --human renders a table with claim, branch, expiry, and next-action columns for an active claim.
A test asserts both behaviors against a fixture with a claim.
